description: Get historical earnings data for a company: EPS actual vs estimate, revenue actual vs estimate, and surprise percentages (beats and misses).

limit.description: Maximum number of earnings periods to return (1-40). Defaults to 8.

ticker.description: Company identifier: the current ticker (e.g. "AAPL"), a former ticker of a renamed or delisted company (e.g. "MIGI", now BGDE), or a numeric SEC CIK (e.g. "320193" or "0000320193"). A former ticker or a CIK is answered with a `resolvedFrom` block naming the current symbol.

name: get_earnings
title: Get Earnings History
